notes:
## JustMic 1.3.1

- Fixed silent soundboard playback when HEAR ME is off. Headphone clip playback now has an independent HEAR SOUNDS switch and is no longer reduced by the voice-monitor volume knob.
- Editor previews play locally even when headphone pad playback is disabled; microphone-only clips still stay out of the headphone mix.
- Fixed missing final audio buffers and very short clips on the headphone output. Both destinations are mixed before playback completes.
- With private monitoring protection enabled, JustMic respects your selected headphone device instead of moving clips to an alternative output.
- Privacy protection remains enabled: live voice is not added to the software headphone mix. Use hardware headphone-only monitoring to hear your voice privately; intentionally played sounds can still be captured by screen sharing.

Settings, presets, sounds and startup preferences are preserved. The updater from 1.3.0 can install this version from Settings > Updates.
